title: ==LEAD TEST ENGINEER - LEAD DATA TESTER==  |  FINANCIAL SYSTEMS QA

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==Lead Test Engineer / Lead Data Tester== with 15+ years of QA experience across financial services and retirement platforms. Experienced translating requirements into end-to-end test scenarios, validating application and report data with SQL, and coordinating automation, defect triage and release delivery. Hands-on with Java, Selenium, Cucumber, Postman, SQL Server, HyperSQL, Jenkins and Git-based CI pipelines.

roles.title: Lead QA Software Engineer | progression from Trainee and Software Tester
roles.meta: February 2011 - September 2026 | Financial Services and Retirement
bullets: Translated project and client requirements into test scenarios, test cases, estimates and plans across the STLC.
Validated report data using SQL queries and performed database and data-file checks with SQL Server Management Studio and PowerSelect.
Checked XML and pipe-delimited data files and enhanced utilities for plan-health reports, PDF comparison, CCD Scrubber and CCD Splitter.
Automated sprint requirements with Java, Selenium WebDriver and Cucumber/BDD and incorporated scripts into the regression suite.
Performed API testing with Postman and coordinated integration and regression execution for project releases.
Scheduled weekly regression through GitLab and GitHub Pipelines; configured Jenkins jobs and test execution schedules.
Triaged defects, retested fixes, published X-Ray results, mentored colleagues and coordinated release deployments.

roles.title: Lead QA Engineer / Senior Quality Analyst
bullets: Supported a customer communications platform integrating data and delivering financial and retirement documents across print, email and online channels.
Used SQL, Postman, XML/data-file validation, Selenium, Java, Cucumber, FTP and PDFBox.

roles.title: Quality Analyst
bullets: Tested a retirement recordkeeping platform across multiple environments and executed Selenium/QTP regression for participant and sponsor applications.
